summary: Sunlands Technology Group filed a Form 6-K announcing a $50 million share repurchase program authorized by its board of directors. The program authorizes repurchases of Class A ordinary shares in the form of American depositary shares over 36 months. No specific price per share, premium, or advisor was named. Repurchases may be made on the open market or through privately negotiated transactions, subject to Rule 10b-18 and expected to be effected under a Rule 10b5-1 plan. The program signals management's confidence in the company's capital position and cash generation. Watch for periodic buyback disclosures to gauge execution pace and impact on share count.
